stock.description: Beijing Biostar Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd. primarily focuses on developing innovative therapies for tumors. The company is dedicated to creating novel anti-cancer drugs, each secured by independent intellectual property rights. A prominent product in its portfolio is the Utidelone injection, a next-generation microtubule inhibitor produced through a unique microbial fermentation process. This enterprise was co-founded by Li Tang and Rong Guo Qiu on July 11, 2002, and operates from its headquarters in Beijing, China.
